'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Kevin Shannon LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
